target.statement: Distilled student (DT/RF) policy utility within 0.011 absolute utility of its causal-forest/BCF teacher on the PIMA obesity (BMI) experiment, evaluated by held-out doubly robust policy value.
target.table_ref: Results section (PIMA BMI teacher-student fidelity/utility table)
target.dataset: PIMA Indians Diabetes Dataset (BMI >=30 obesity state, diabetes outcome)

compute.basis: No paper code released (only the EconML library link); the pipeline (causal-structure-informed covariate roles, OOF causal forest + BCF teachers via StochTree, DT/RF distillation, K-means/causal-tree comparators, selective-shift doubly robust evaluation with bootstrap) must be rebuilt from prose, and BCF MCMC plus bootstrap on a small table is CPU-bound but nontrivial to reimplement faithfully.

blockers: No released code or configs for the distillation/policy pipeline
Causal-structure-informed covariate roles are prespecified from a prior paper and not fully specified here
BCF teacher requires StochTree/R or equivalent reimplementation
Exact held-out split, bootstrap protocol, and DR estimator details must be inferred
title: Conditional Average Treatment Effect Distillation for Hypothetical State-Intervention Targeting Under Budget Constraints
